svg.title: Three parcels whose codes expire on day 3, noticed lazily and by the sweep
svg.desc: P2, P3 and P4 were deposited on day 0 at 09:05, 09:10 and 09:15 with a three-day window. Their codes stop working on day 3 at the same times. Between expiry and 11:01 they are overdue but nothing has recorded it; enterCode would still refuse the code because it compares with the clock. At 11:01 the customer types P2 code and it is refused, which records P2 as expired; the sweep then records P3 and P4; the carrier takes all three.
svg.text: P2, P3, P4: deposited day 0, three-day codes
the code check reads the clock, so amber codes are refused even before the sweep runs
